name: HARTA
recent: Hartalega 于 2026 年 11 月 12 日公布季度业绩，净利按年大增约 79% 至 3280 万令吉，主要因平均售价走高。此前于 9 月 3 日举行第 20 届常年股东大会，所有决议均获通过。同期，KWAP 在 9 月至 10 月间多次申报大股东权益变动。
notable: 公布最新季度业绩，净利按年增长约 79% 至 3280 万令吉。
第 20 届常年股东大会于 2026 年 9 月 3 日举行，所有决议获股东通过。
KWAP 在 2026 年 9 月至 10 月间多次申报大股东权益变动。
earnings: 最新一季（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）营收为 6.058 亿令吉，按季增长 17.5%，按年增长 9.5%；净利为 7003 万令吉，按季增长 73.1%，按年增长 455.4%；净利率为 11.6%，高于上一季的 7.9%。

recent_en: Hartalega announced its quarterly results on 12 Nov 2026, with net profit up about 79% year-on-year to RM32.8 million, mainly driven by higher average selling prices. It earlier held its 20th AGM on 3 Sep 2026, where all resolutions were passed. Meanwhile, KWAP filed multiple substantial shareholder changes between September and October.
notable_en: Announced latest quarterly results with net profit up about 79% year-on-year to RM32.8 million.
Held its 20th AGM on 3 Sep 2026, with all resolutions passed by shareholders.
KWAP filed multiple substantial shareholder changes between September and October 2026.
earnings_en: For the latest quarter ended 30 Jun 2026, revenue was RM605.8 million, up 17.5% QoQ and 9.5% YoY; net income was RM70.0 million, up 73.1% QoQ and 455.4% YoY; net margin was 11.6%, higher than 7.9% in the previous quarter.
